G1.name: Code Standards
G1.desc: Formatting, lint, static analysis, and types all clean. PASS = zero errors; warnings acceptable when documented.

G2.name: Security
G2.desc: No OWASP Top 10 violations; input validated at the boundary; authorization enforced; no secrets in source; no unbound raw SQL. FAIL on any Critical/High finding.

G3.name: Alignment
G3.desc: Implementation matches the original request: complete, no scope creep, solves the stated problem.

G4.name: Test Coverage
G4.desc: Suite green with meaningful assertions; new behavior lands with tests.
commands: docker exec example_app php artisan test

G5.name: DevOps Readiness
G5.desc: Migrations reversible; new env vars documented in .env.example; config keys have sensible defaults.

G6.name: Accessibility
G6.desc: WCAG 2.1 AA on every user-facing change: semantic elements, keyboard operability with visible focus, labelled inputs, AA contrast, honest alt text, announced dynamic updates. FAIL on any serious/critical automated finding or unmet reviewer-checklist item. Changes with no user-facing surface record N/A with one line of justification — never silently skipped.
commands: docker exec example_app npx eslint resources/js --max-warnings 0
docker exec example_app npx axe http://localhost --exit

test: docker exec example_app php artisan test
